steps.note: A fresh 14.1 VPX has it DISABLED: new SSL vservers then allow SSLv3/TLS1.0/1.1 and no TLS1.3. The CLI asks Y/N, NITRO does not. Cannot be undone (MANUAL) - take a snapshot first.

steps.comment: Least-privilege NITRO user for certificate deployment (e.g. netscaler-acme), no nsroot
steps.note: Password only via environment: $env:CERT_USER_PW = Read-Host 'password' -MaskInput. The binding is the LAST step on purpose: if anything fails after it, the rollback has least to do.
